proof_body:
by
  intro a b M ha hb
  have ba : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨M, fun n => (le_abs_self _).trans (ha n)⟩
  have bb : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop b :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨M, fun n => (le_abs_self _).trans (hb n)⟩
  have bs : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) Filter.atTop (fun n => a n + b n) :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨-M + -M, fun n => add_le_add (abs_le.1 (ha n)).1 (abs_le.1 (hb n)).1⟩
  refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε => ?_
  have h1 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, a n < Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop + ε / 2 :=
    Filter.eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (by linarith) ba
  have h2 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, b n < Filter.limsup b Filter.atTop + ε / 2 :=
    Filter.eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (by linarith) bb
  refine Filter.limsup_le_of_le bs.isCoboundedUnder_le ?_
  filter_upwards [h1, h2] with n hn1 hn2
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ n, |a n| ≤ M) → (∀ n, |b n| ≤ M) → Filter.limsup (fun n => a n + b n) Filter.atTop ≤ Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop + Filter.limsup b Filter.atTop
